notes: THE DEFECT, in one line: recal_149's credit was weighted by `_sample_weight` = tracked 6ft+ attempts / 500 and by nothing else. A COUNT IS NOT A LOAD — the series counts the shots a man was NEAR, so a switch-everything specialist's count rises with his assignment while his season stays a bench season.

Andre Roberson '15: 19.2 mpg (1,286 minutes over 67 games), 0.8 spg, 0.4 bpg, BPM -0.7, usage 9.0, and NO ballot in 2015 — his drep 0.422 is the 2017 All-Defensive 2nd decayed two years, which is what puts a no-ballot season inside the voted band. 328 defended 6ft+ shots at -3.4% = sample weight 0.66. recal_149 moved him perdef 82 -> 91 and DEF 81 -> 88 on an unchanged box line.

THE CLASS, MEASURED (recal_117's rule, the same way recal_130 and recal_145 measured theirs): of the 135 cards this credit actually pays — q > 0, sample > 0, wv > 0, and the max() binding — minutes per game run p25 28.40 · median 31.79 · p75 34.04 · p90 35.85. Roberson '15 is the LOWEST-minute card in the entire class, and the second-largest gain in it (his own '16, at 22.2 mpg, is the largest). BAND_FULL = 34.0.

WHY NOT recal_96's 24-MINUTE BENCH BOUNDARY — it was measured FIRST and it is the frontier: 24 minutes sits below this class's own 25th percentile, so a ramp that saturates there is a no-op for 132 of the 135 cards, moves 7 cards in the whole file, and taxes essentially the subject alone. A load line only one card can feel is a per-player override wearing a formula's clothes. It lands him perdef 88 / DEF 86 — one point outside 83 +-2.

WHY NOT recal_130's `min(1, mpg / 34.7)` class line either: without a foot it charges every card a share, so Amen Thompson '25 (32.2 mpg) and Wembanyama '26 (29.2) pay 7-15% of a credit they earned in full, and those are recal_149's own pins. The 12-minute foot is what keeps full-time defenders whole.

FOOTPRINT: 48 cards move, EVERY ONE OF THEM DOWN (the term is a one-way max(), so a rise is impossible by construction and none was observed). Largest perdef move 7 (Matisse Thybulle '20, 19.8 mpg), largest DEF move 5, largest OVR move 2. No card falls below the value it had before recal_149.

ANCHORS: 155 of 155 pass, mean |error| 0.77 (it was 0.79). Amen Thompson '24/'25/'26, Draymond '16, Jrue '21/'17, Herbert Jones '23, Dort '25/'26, Kawhi '16/'17, Marcus Smart '19, Gobert '19 and Fat Lever '88 are BYTE-IDENTICAL. Wembanyama '26 attr:perdef 77 -> 76 against recal_101's 74 +-3.

TESTS: npx vitest run — 39 files, 411 tests, all green; the OKC franchise mark in tests/seasonstrip.test.ts did NOT need re-pointing. HARNESS: npm run harness — all nine tactics PASS on main's constants, no tax re-swept.
COMPUTE_OVR IS UNTOUCHED. The whole round is one multiplication inside build_ratings.py's perdef term; OFF/DEF/OVR and the team dials move only because perdef did.
cost: Andre Roberson '16 is NOT pinned: his 22.2-minute season follows the subject to perdef 88 / DEF 85 as declared collateral. If Tomer wants '16 held higher, it cannot be bought inside this term without giving the subject his credit back — the two seasons share one ramp and the '15 card is 25% of the '16 card through the season blend.

BAND_FOOT/BAND_FULL (12.0/34.0) is the THIRD load line in the file: recal_96/151 at 12/24, recal_145 at 12/35.7, and now 12/34.0. All three are the same shape with a class-measured full point; a later round that wants one line for all of them has three measured classes on the record.
pipeline_version is recorded as 157 (main's stamp) so the receipt reads true on this branch; the integrator restamps it with the batch's highest round after the single merged regeneration.

The other four parallel rounds (158 career_rep/wv, 160 rimprot vote reinforcement, 161 creation_factor, 162 no-vote rimprot height) all touch perdef or rimprot inputs. This round multiplies recal_149's credit and does not move TRK_BAND_LO/TOP/W, so it folds with any of them; but a round that changes wv or drep changes WHO is in this term's 135-card class, and BAND_FULL = 34.0 was measured on the class as it stands at pipeline 157.
